model: ElectroVap MC (ELMC) electrode steam humidifier (V3 controller)
applies_to: Devatec ElectroVap ELMC electrode steam humidifiers with the V3 controller; the same table is printed for the EHU-750, KIT MC and SB steam-bath generator.
summary: The ElectroVap MC (ELMC) is an electrode-boiler steam humidifier whose V3 controller talks Modbus RTU or BACnet MS/TP on RS485. The BACnet map gives contactor, level, valve and relay states as Binary Inputs, a start/stop Binary Output, current, run status, error code and steam output as Analog Inputs, and setpoint, demand, capacity limit and drain settings as Analog Values.
notes: The manual's table has no read/write column; access is inferred from the Modbus register area (coils and holding registers writable).
The description column is used as the object name. The English print labels the Analog Input class "Have" (a mistranslation); the hex IDs confirm Analog Input.
Rows marked "Not used" (BV 1, AV 7, AV 8) are left out.
Option relays 3 and 4 are printed as BV 1 and BV 2 with the same hex IDs as the BV 1 and BV 2 rows above them, so their real instances are unclear; they are left out.
AI 12 is not printed. Current, steam production and the control signal are scaled by 10.
BV 2 and BV 3 only apply with the SB 8-relay option card.

source.title: ElectroVap ELMC Series Instruction & Operation Manual

integration.summary: Select BACnet MS/TP in the network menu, set a bus address (1-32) and speed, then start/stop the unit with BO 0 and send demand or RH through AV 5 with the control type set to digital control. Watch run status, error code and steam output.

minimum_points.name: RH or demand value (digital or digital probe).
minimum_points.why: Demand or RH from the BMS, 1-100 %

integration.enable: BO 0 On/Off BMS command starts (1) or stops (0) the unit.
integration.remote_sensors: With the control signal type set to digital control in the humidifier menu, the BMS writes RH or demand (1-100 %) to AV 5.
setup: RS485 on connector J2 (1 Data-, 2 Data+, 3 GND); SW1 switches the line termination and bias resistors.
The network menu selects Modbus RTU 8-N-1, 8-N-2 or BACnet MS/TP, a bus address from 1 to 32 and the bus speed.
The communication table lists 2400 to 230400 baud (9600 default) with 1 stop bit on BACnet MS/TP; the menu page lists 1200 to 9600 b/s.
gotchas: Steam capacity limit (AV 4) is a fixed setting, not a control command.
AV 6 is a temperature setpoint (25-55 °C) on the SB steam bath, not RH.
